title: Open-Source Autonomous Driving System Analysis and Multi-Disciplinary Hardware-in-the-Loop Research Paradigm with Reinforcement-Learning Testing and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-source autonomous driving systems provide an inspectable software foundation for intelligent vehicle research. Under real-vehicle deployment conditions, the recording and review of experimental conditions are important for interpreting system behavior and reusing experimental results. However, in a shared real-vehicle environment involving multiple vehicles, task processes, code modifications, and hardware testing feedback are often distributed across different teams and experimental stages, making it challenging to maintain continuous and reviewable experimental records. To address this limitation, this paper examines an Apollo-on-Hongqi EV environment and proposes a real-vehicle experimental framework. The framework connects multi-vehicle experiments, repository-based code reuse and software-hardware testing feedback within a unified review process. translated_title: 开源自动驾驶系统分析与多学科硬件在环研究范式：结合强化学习测试与大语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.30179v1 公告类型：新 摘要：开源自动驾驶系统为智能车辆研究提供了可审查的软件基础。在实车部署条件下，实验条件的记录与审查对于解释系统行为和复用实验结果至关重要。然而，在涉及多辆车辆、任务流程、代码修改和硬件测试反馈的共享实车环境中，这些信息往往分散在不同团队和实验阶段，使得维护连续且可审查的实验记录面临挑战。为解决这一局限，本文研究了Apollo-红旗电动车环境，并提出了一种实车实验框架。该框架将多车辆实验、基于代码仓库的代码复用以及软硬件测试反馈连接到统一的审查流程中。大语言模型和基于强化学习的测试作为辅助组件用于记录（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文基于Apollo-红旗电动车环境提出了一种实车实验框架，将多车辆实验、基于代码仓库的代码复用与软硬件测试反馈整合进统一的审查流程，并利用大语言模型和强化学习测试作为辅助记录组件，以解决共享实车环境中实验记录分散、难以持续审查的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a real-vehicle experimental framework for an Apollo-on-Hongqi EV environment that integrates multi-vehicle experiments, repository-based code reuse, and software-hardware testing feedback into a unified review process, using large language models and reinforcement-learning-based testing as auxiliary components to address the challenge of maintaining continuous, reviewable experimental records in shared real-vehicle settings.
